sloka: अयम् पितृ वयस्यो मे गृध्र राजो जरा अन्वितः ।शेते विनिहतो भूमौ मम भाग्य विपर्ययात् ॥३-६७-२७॥
transliteration: ayam pitṛ vayasyo me gṛdhra rājo jarā anvitaḥ ।śete vinihato bhūmau mama bhāgya viparyayāt ॥3-67-27॥

translations.english: This aged king of birds is my father's friend. To my illluck, he is struck down and is lying on the ground.
